about.text: PixelHero is a 2D MMORPG adventure. You play as an adventurer amongst others and explore the world of PixelHero. PixelHero is based on BrowserQuest, which started as a fork of BrowserQuest; in honour to the original idea, the assets have been preserved and expanded upon. The source code of the original PixelHero is on its {{github}}.
